xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:RemarksWebsiteDisseminationFor:
1. The Board of Directors, at its meeting on 1 October 2026, inter alia, has approved, the following proposals, subject to such regulatory, statutory approvals as may be required, including approval of the shareholders of the Company
a. Raising of capital through a Qualified Institutions Placement for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 11,700 Crore
b. Preferential issue of warrants convertible into equivalent number of Equity Shares for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 5,800 Crore

2. The Shareholders at their meeting held on 2 November 2026 has approved the above mentioned issues and the results of the said meeting was informed to the exchanges on 4 November 2026 by way of Scrutiniser Report.

3. Further, this is an Outcome of QIP 2026- Special Committee of Board for opening of the issue, approval of PPD and issuance of equity shares subsequently. The Company has already filed an outcome for the Board meeting held on 1 October 2026 wherein the Board had approved the issuance of equity shares through QIP.
